title: Tàu điện ngầm cuối
about: Round x18 (album 13), the user: "làm album và chuyển sang sáng tác album tiếp theo": electronic sleep ambient (style ngu-dt) as albums 10-11, on a less common progression of its own (template 3), slow (52 bpm), pad, pianoarp, sub, strings, an improvised glass tune with a long echo. No drums. An original piece.
